description.zh: 把本机 ComfyUI 变成绘画 agent：12 个工具、分族提示词指南、PNG 配方反解、缺失模型搜索安装，以及「极简绘画」预设。

description.en: Video link to script: a sidebar workbench with player, transcript and publish-ready export; bundles the video2text skill.
description.zh: 视频链接转文案的侧栏工作台：播放器 + 逐字稿 + 发布导出，自带 video2text skill。

description.en: Quote selections and attach region screenshots as workspace file references in DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 选中文字或截取屏幕区域，一键带引用或截图文件插入输入框，不自动发送。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中途切换四种内置 Agent 模式（标准 / PTC / 极简 / 创造）· Switch DSH agent modes mid-conversation
description.zh: 会话进行中随时切换标准、PTC、极简、创造四种 Agent 模式，不用重开对话。

description.en: Pure chat mode for DeepSeek Harness: a tool-less conversation preset with per-session persona, temperature and capability switches, plus one-click hand-off into a standard session.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个纯聊天模式，不带任何工具，还能按会话调人设和温度，随时一键切回标准会话。

description.en: Build named subagents and skills in a sidebar panel, then call any subagent by name in a conversation. Each subagent selects a model, reasoning effort, spawn or fork mode, a tool allowlist and skills; skills can be global, per workspace or per conversation.
description.zh: 在侧栏里创建具名子智能体和技能，并在对话中按名字调用。子智能体可配置模型、思考强度、spawn/fork 启动方式、工具白名单与技能；技能可全局、按工作区或按单个会话生效。

description.en: Persists unsent composer attachments per session, so images and files pasted into the input box survive page switches, conversation switches and app restarts: the bytes are mirrored in IndexedDB and handed back through the official createDrafts/addAttachments channel, and are dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.

description.en: Multi-provider quota and usage dashboard for DSH: DeepSeek balances, GLM, MiniMax, OpenCode and Codex subscription windows, and OpenAI organization spend, plus a Models tab that edits providers, model catalogs and reasoning-effort settings on top of the official DSH model settings. Registers the provider_quota, quota_color_settings and provider_company_rules agent tools.
description.zh: DSH 的多供应商配额与用量面板：DeepSeek 余额，GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode 与 Codex 的订阅窗口，以及 OpenAI 组织消费；「模型」页签在 DSH 官方模型设置之上编辑供应商、模型目录与推理强度。注册 provider_quota、quota_color_settings、provider_company_rules 三个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Design review desk in the sidebar. The impeccable skill ships inside the plugin, so it works out of the box: scan a project path or URL with 62 deterministic rules (no model calls, no API key), see the findings grouped by rule and where they are, and turn each of the 24 skill commands into a one-click prompt that copies itself or starts a new conversation. The detection engine (about 21 MB) is downloaded once in the background on first load; until then the panel says what is happening instead of offering a scan that cannot run. Every command and rule is translated, so the panel reads as one language instead of half English, and the whole thing is set like a magazine page rather than a settings form. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 侧栏里的设计审校台。impeccable 技能随插件自带，装上就能用：填项目路径或网址，跑 62 条确定性规则（不调模型、不用 API key），按规则分组列出问题位置；24 条技能命令变成点一下就复制、或直接开新对话的提示词。检测引擎（约 21 MB）首次加载时在后台下载一次，没下完前面板会说明状态，而不是给一个跑不起来的扫描框。24 条命令、62 条规则、6 个分类全部有中文名称与说明，界面是整块中文而不是半中半英，整页按刊物排版，不是一堆设置表单。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Domain-agnostic whitebox project board with a persistent conversation box at every level (locked to the selected task), blueprint-driven layout, dynamic loading progress, SVG dependency flowchart, burndown, edit cards with diffs, voice input and auto TTS broadcast. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 领域无关项目白盒看板：每层保留对话框并锁定当前任务、蓝图驱动布局、动态加载进度、SVG依赖流程图、燃尽图、编辑卡diff、语音输入与自动播报。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds piano_score, which takes one audio link and writes a playable score: staff PNGs, numbered notation, MusicXML, MIDI. It transcribes the background music and drops the vocal; drums and non-melodic parts are folded into the left hand. The three tiers are one arrangement in three keys and differ only in the key it is written in, ranked on the black keys the hand actually presses, so easy is the one with the fewest; playback restores the original pitch. Long audio can be previewed with seconds. The project is called everything2chart; this catalog entry keeps the name dsh-pianochart, which only says which host it plugs into.
description.zh: 带一个 piano_score 工具：给一条音频链接，产出一份能弹的谱，含五线谱 PNG、简谱、MusicXML、MIDI。只转录背景音乐、去掉人声；鼓组和非旋律声部并入左手。三档是同一套编配的三种调，只差写成的调，按手上真正按到的黑键数排，所以 easy 最少；回放恢复原调。长音频可以用 seconds 先出一段预览。项目叫 everything2chart，这个目录条目保留 dsh-pianochart 这个名字，它只说明插进哪个宿主。

description.en: Moves Shell temporary files out of the workspace, grants write access to the temp directory, explains where temporary files go via the system prompt, and cleans up expired temporary files and orphaned attachments on a schedule. description.en: Browser-style session tab strip for the DSH web header: one tab per open session, close others / close right / close all from the tab context menu, a reopen-closed history of the last 50 tabs, middle-click close, running and completed status dots aligned with the sidebar, drag reorder, hover bubbles showing project and git branch, and a settings page. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 网页端顶部的浏览器式会话标签条：每个打开的会话一个标签，右键菜单可关闭其他/右侧/全部标签页，可重新打开最近关闭的 50 个标签，支持中键关闭、与侧边栏一致的运行/完成状态圆点、拖拽排序，悬停气泡显示所属项目与 git 分支，附配置页。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DSH 布局交换插件：文件/浏览器居中，聊天置于右侧，可拖动并记忆布局
description.zh: 把文件和浏览器挪到中间、聊天放右边，还能拖动并记住布局，让工作区更顺手。

description.en: DSH plugin: LLM fingerprint detection for models registered in DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DSH 里注册的模型写一串“随机”整数，就能看出这个渠道背后最像哪个模型。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a profile injected into every conversation, candidate memories, on-demand recall, timer-based organizing, and Git sync of the data folder.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上长期记忆，自动记住你的偏好和结论，换电脑也能同步。

description.en: 多模型智能协同调度插件 for the agent runtime：模型池+能力标签、任务自动拆解、按强项智能路由、结果融合、人工指定模型、失败自动降级、图片生成与完整调用链路日志。DAG/路由算法复用 mmcp(MIT)。
description.zh: 一个任务自动拆成小任务，分派给最擅长的模型处理，再合成完整结果。

description.en: Per-persona cross-session Markdown memory & Tobs persona mode (DM, group chat, work-process timeline, primary persona history recall) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给每个人格一份独立的跨会话长期记忆，还能玩转 Tobs 人格模式，私聊群聊、工作过程时间轴和历史检索都支持。

description.en: DSH plugin publishing assistant: preflight, submit, review, publish and recall
description.zh: DSH 插件发布一条龙：自动检查、生成 entry、开 PR、发布 npm，还能按版本撤回。

description.en: Role-layered subagent orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness — per-role context/tool isolation, Web UI model & OAR routing, step budgets, and parallel write guardrails. DeepSeek Harness 子智能体角色编排插件，提供角色隔离、可视化模型与外部运行时路由、步数预算与并行写入护栏。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的子智能体按角色分工，隔离上下文和工具，还能配模型、控预算、防并发写冲突。

description.en: DSH 插件：侧边栏会话行补成三行——标题、你最后问的那句话、agent 预设与正在跑的子智能体和后台任务
description.zh: 把侧边栏会话行扩成三行，标题、最后提问、预设和运行中的子智能体、后台任务一眼看清。

description.en: SSH tools for DeepSeek Harness: password + TOTP two-factor login, with host management in the settings page
description.zh: 让 DSH 非交互完成 SSH 密码加 TOTP 双因素登录，还能在设置页管理主机。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用你的 ChatGPT 套餐额度。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接登录 ChatGPT 账号，用你的套餐额度调用模型，省去另开窗口的麻烦。

description.en: Drive your own Windows windows without moving the cursor: one tool, eleven actions, and a per-call verdict receipt that says who reported the success. DSH plugin.
description.zh: 不用挪鼠标就能操控你自己的 Windows 窗口，一个工具搞定十一种操作，每次调用还附成功回执。

description.en: 零一·凌界｜零一玩家｜01PLAYER · DSH 黑白机械终端主题，含动态数据雨与桌面入场衔接
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上黑白机械终端风主题，带动态数据雨和桌面入场动画，界面更有氛围感。

description.en: DSH 审计工作台插件：序时账清洗 / 现金流量表编写 / 对方科目分析 / 会计分录测试。A DSH plugin for Chinese accounting: journal cleaning, cash-flow statements, contra-account analysis and entry testing.
A non-destructive claude.ai-inspired visual skin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上一套 claude.ai 风格的皮肤，明暗主题都有，不改动原有功能。

description.en: Codex 没有远程入口，会话和 CLI 都在那台电脑上。本插件把本机 Codex 会话接进 DSH 侧栏：按项目列出、点开读取、派发任务在后台续跑；面板复用 DSH 登录连接，已配对的手机也能操作，出门在外接着推进电脑上的任务。Codex has no remote entry point. Put local Codex sessions in the DSH sidebar and keep them moving from a paired phone.
description.zh: 把本机 Codex 会话接进 DSH 侧栏，出门也能派任务、看进度、收结果。

description.en: 把小米 MiMo 桌面 App 的订阅模型接进 DeepSeek Harness —— 复用桌面端登录态，无需 API Key，无常驻进程
description.zh: 把小米 MiMo 桌面 App 里已登录的模型接进 DSH，不用 API Key，也没有常驻进程。

description.en: Production-grade DeepSeek Harness (DSH) worker orchestrator: persistent sessions, dynamic port discovery, per-task permissions, Windows worktree fallback, and report auto-offload.
DSH plugin · a bottom-right, always-on-top desktop toast for DeepSeek Harness: it alerts you when an approval or question is pending, or when a turn ends. · 待确认、待回答或任务结束时，在屏幕右下角弹出置顶提醒卡片。
description.zh: 待审批、待回答或任务结束时，在屏幕右下角弹出置顶提醒卡片，点一下就能把 DSH 窗口拉到前台。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin suite: stage gates, handoff artifacts, project memory and a strict six-role subagent pipeline. Built on DSH built-in plugins only.
StarCraft II Galaxy Editor bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness: editor automation, .SC2Map MPQ read/write, trigger search, Galaxy linting
description.zh: 让 AI 直接操作星际争霸 II 银河编辑器，自动改地图、查触发器、检查 Galaxy 代码。

description.en: Anchors a message, compresses the conversation after it into one memory block when the context crosses a threshold, and withdraws the original span in place, so a long session can continue with its persona and memory intact. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在任意消息上立锚点，上下文到线后把锚点之后的对话压成一块记忆并原地撤回原文，让长会话继续时人设和记忆都还在。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DSH 插件：会话顶栏「图谱」标签，把当前对话的中的历史关键词画成方便定位回忆的点线图
Dispatch tasks and files to DSH running on another machine in your LAN: the remote side runs the agent turn, and the answer plus output files come back to the conversation that started it.
description.zh: 把任务和文件派给局域网里另一台电脑的 DSH 跑，结果和产出文件自动回到当前对话。

description.en: DSH 长图阅读插件：按空白行切分超长截图，切口不压字，每片按模型 1:1 像素预算计算高度
description.zh: 超长截图按空白行智能切片，不切断文字，一次调用就能让模型完整读完长图。

description.en: DSH 插件：在侧边栏底部常驻迷你音乐播放器，搜索、发现、播放无损音乐。DeepSeek Harness sidebar mini music player.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏底部常驻迷你播放器，边工作边搜歌听无损音乐，不打断对话。

description.en: tools for connecting with MCP server by login page. work with https://github.com/0xHertz/Spring-Boot-MCP-Starter
description.zh: 在侧边栏图形化管理 MCP 外部系统连接，不用手写配置文件，还能一键测试连通性。

description.en: Fork of dsh-ops: bash, PowerShell 7 and Rust file/search tools for DSH on Windows, with OPS-PTC batched tool calls to reduce token usage.
description.zh: dsh-ops 的分叉：为 Windows 上的 DSH 提供 bash、PowerShell 7 与 Rust 文件/搜索工具，并以 OPS-PTC 批量调用减少 token 消耗。

description.en: DSH 局域网同步插件：Windows 与安卓接着聊，原标题、共享文件与插件随 Wi-Fi 同步。LAN sync for DeepSeek Harness and DSH Go.
description.zh: Windows 和安卓连同一个 Wi-Fi 就能同步对话、文件和插件，电脑聊到一半换手机接着聊。

description.en: Phone access to the DSH Web GUI over a password-gated Cloudflare quick tunnel; the phone uses a browser, with no app and no VPN. Installs either as this plugin or as a launchd/systemd service, so the gate and its tunnel URL stay up across DSH restarts. Attaches to the running desktop app on its random loopback port by minting the browser-session cookie DSH would mint, leaving DSH unmodified, or proxies a fixed dsh web. Adds a login page, a signed cookie (180 days by default) and per-IP login throttling.
description.zh: 在手机上访问 DSH Web GUI，通过带密码网关的 Cloudflare 快速隧道；手机只用浏览器，免 App 免 VPN。可作为插件安装，也可作为 launchd/systemd 常驻服务安装，让网关和隧道网址在 DSH 重启后依然有效。可连接正在运行的桌面版——按 DSH 的方式现签 browser-session cookie 以适配其随机回环端口，DSH 本体零改动——也可反代固定的 dsh web。提供登录页、签名 cookie（默认 180 天）和按 IP 的登录限流。

description.en: 插件列表说人话：点一下把 dsh-bili-scroll 改成「刷B站」，插件更新冲掉了也能一键找回。
在 DSH Web 的已安装插件列表检查并安装兼容更新
description.zh: 在已安装插件列表里一键检查 GitHub 更新，支持逐个或批量安装并提示重启。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装一个十方向一体的安全研究人格：十本 playbook 同时挂载，九条输出纪律写进人格，硬边界不动审批与沙箱。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装一个十方向一体的安全研究人格，十本 playbook 同时挂载，不用来回切模式。

description.en: dsh提示词管理工具
DSH 原生右侧栏里的 AI 远程工作台：SSH/SFTP、资源监控与 PDF 编辑
DeepSeek Harness safe-mode recovery console: minimal TUI, history, repair, model/provider management
dsh 插件
description.zh: 在侧边栏右键就能把会话挪到别的项目，或者直接永久删除，整理起来更省心。

description.en: Google Antigravity CLI（agy）子智能体 Provider：让 DSH 智能体把单个任务交给 agy 执行并取回结果 / One-shot Antigravity CLI (agy) subagent provider: hand one task to agy and get the answer back
description.zh: 把单个任务交给 Google Antigravity CLI 执行并取回结果，让 DSH 智能体多一个能干活的子智能体。

description.en: Task-completion notifications with result previews, links to source sessions, local notification history, and optional sounds. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 任务完成通知，支持结果摘要、来源会话回跳、通知历史和可选提示音。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DSH 版 Telegram 频道归档工具包：把 telegram-channel-archiver 命令行封装成 5 个可在对话里直接调用的原生工具（环境自检 / 看下载进度 / 扫频道索引 / 启停下载 / 建归档任务），不用记命令行参数、不用常开终端就能管理整频道视频与文件的批量下载。
description.zh: 在对话里直接批量下载 Telegram 频道的视频和文件，不用记命令行参数，也不用一直开着终端。

description.en: A shared plan board for you and the agent in the DSH right sidebar — stages, dependencies and due dates, kept as a passive reminder of where the work stands.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右栏放一块你和助手共用的计划白板，按阶段记录待办、依赖和截止日期，跨会话提醒进度。

description.en: Token budget gateway for DeepSeek Harness: one admission gate for every model call, session/day/month cost caps, alert/block/degrade, and a /gateway control surface.
Companion-first verbatim long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (SQLite + FTS5 + hybrid vector search).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一份逐字不忘的长期记忆，聊天内容原样存进本地 SQLite，还能混合检索快速找回。

description.en: 鲸鱼娘控制台：DSH 插件，一键启动/关闭本地桌宠、语音和本地模型
description.zh: 在设置页一键开关本地桌宠、语音和本地模型，Windows 用户管理鲸鱼娘全家桶更省事。

description.en: 《鸣潮》(Wuthering Waves) 自机角色提取、Blender 卡渲动作展示与标准化 UE 交接包 — DeepSeek Harness (Cordis 4) 专用插件
description.zh: 一键提取《鸣潮》自机角色模型，自动生成 Blender 卡渲动作展示和标准 UE 交接包。

description.en: Serves the DSH Go workspace folder over FTP and WebDAV with a built-in browser panel, so a phone file manager such as MT Manager can mount it read-write.
description.zh: 内置面板一键开启 FTP 与 WebDAV，把 DSH Go 的工作区目录转发出去，MT 管理器等客户端可直接挂载读写。

description.en: Publish local Markdown files as Feishu (Lark) documents from DeepSeek Harness: upload to Drive, import as docx, return the doc URL.
description.zh: 在会话里把本地 Markdown 一键上传飞书云空间，自动转成飞书文档并返回链接。

description.en: 面向原神「千星奇域」创作者的 AI 辅助开发插件
Plan portrait shoots in DSH and import the ordered shot list into Muse Frame to review framing, lighting and wardrobe continuity.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中编排人像拍摄计划，逐镜确定取景、光线与服装连续性，再将镜头清单导入 Muse Frame 工作台。

description.en: 轨迹省钱优化器：DSH 会话轨迹 token 浪费分析 + waterfall 执行层强制拦截/截断。Trajectory cost optimizer with enforcement layer for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 实时分析DSH会话轨迹中的token浪费点，并在工具调用前后强制拦截截断，零额外成本帮您省钱。

description.en: Stock market and finance data for stocks listed in the US, Hong Kong, China A-share, Japan and Korea markets, for investment and equity research: financial statements and ratios, earnings reports and filings with full-text search (SEC and exchange filings), stock prices, news, analyst ratings, insider trades and earnings-call summaries; coverage varies by dataset. Ten drillr MCP tools (mcp__drillr__*) through the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, including read-only SQL over financial and alternative-data tables, plus a research skill that tells the agent which tool to use. A Settings → drillr page stores your drillr API key in the dsh credential store after a test call to the gateway accepts it; a drillr account is required.
description.zh: 美股、港股、A 股、日股和韩股上市公司的股票与金融数据，用于投资研究：财务报表和财务指标、年报季报等财报与公告全文检索（SEC 文件、交易所公告）、股价行情、新闻、分析师评级、内部人交易和业绩电话会摘要，各数据集覆盖的市场不同。通过官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 接入 drillr 托管的 MCP 服务，提供 10 个工具（mcp__drillr__*），包括财务表和另类数据表的只读 SQL，并附带一个告诉智能体该用哪个工具的研究 skill。「设置 → drillr」页面先用 key 试调一次 gateway，通过后才把 API key 存进 dsh 凭据库；需要 drillr 账号。

description.en: Read-only context occupancy, provider cache-read trends, and native compaction structure with optional billion-context-dsh metadata support.
description.zh: 只读查看上下文水位、提供商缓存读取趋势与原生压缩结构，可选识别 billion-context-dsh 元数据。

description.en: Recovers known invalid explicit model arguments in DSH subagent and subagent_fork calls by removing the full override and retrying once through the original guarded pipeline.
description.zh: 恢复 DSH subagent 与 subagent_fork 调用中已知的无效显式模型参数，移除完整覆盖后通过原有守卫管线重试一次。

description.en: Bottom-right whale widget showing DeepSeek balance, today's spend from the official usage API, per-turn cost narrated after each turn, and a peak/off-peak pricing countdown, with six expressions, click-to-refresh, weather and a bilingual (中文/English) UI.
description.zh: 右下角小鲸鱼挂件：显示 DeepSeek 余额与官网口径的今日用量，每轮结束播报本轮花费，并提供峰谷定价倒计时；另有六种状态立绘、点击刷新、天气查询与中英双语界面。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: shows the current session's spend, priced by DeepSeek's peak and off-peak rate windows.

Declares the wire protocol for the opencode-go route so models the installed catalog does not describe resolve, adds the DeepSeek V4.1 models to that route when they are missing, and attaches a per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode requests.
description.zh: 为 opencode-go 路由声明 wire 协议，使目录未收录的模型可以正常使用；该路由缺少 DeepSeek V4.1 模型时自动补上，并为发往 OpenCode 的请求附加按会话的 x-opencode-session 头。

description.en: 🕊️ Postbird 信鸽 — AI 替你跑邮件和文档这趟腿。DeepSeek Harness 办公插件，14 个工具：群发/分诊/归档/求职台账/Word/PPT/表格。QQ·163·Gmail 通吃，数据不出本机。

MusicBee playlist and library toolkit: scan a music library into a JSON index, write ID3/Vorbis/MP4 tags, build validated dsh (3dj) party playlists, and rewrite .mbp playlist files. Windows and a local MusicBee install required.
description.zh: MusicBee 歌单与曲库工具：扫曲库建 JSON 索引、写 ID3/Vorbis/MP4 标签、按整场规则排 3dj 舞会歌单、批量重写 .mbp 歌单；需 Windows 与本机 MusicBee。

description.en: Shows each subagent's model name on its row's name line in the session-header subagent panels (root panel, sibling switcher, and children panel), and widens those panels to 460px. The name comes from each subagent session's recorded model selection; a subagent without one, and external subagents, show a dash.
description.zh: 在会话顶部的子代理面板（根面板、兄弟切换面板、子面板）中，于每个子代理的名称行显示其模型名，并把面板加宽到 460px。模型名取自各子代理会话记录的模型选择；没有记录的子代理和 external 子代理显示“—”。

description.en: Opens a Chromium window in the right sidebar, with one containerized browser and persistent profile per workspace, and one opt-in agent tool for navigation and page interaction. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏打开 Chromium 窗口，每个工作区各有一个容器化浏览器与持久化配置，并提供需逐会话授权的单一 Agent 工具，用于导航与页面交互。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: All-in-one ops plugin for SSH, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD and Argo Workflows. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 一体化运维插件：SSH 远程运维 / K8s 集群管理 / Helm Chart 管理 / ArgoCD / Argo Workflows。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Make animations with the agent: scenes are written as editable code, with timeline preview and annotation beside the chat and frame-accurate MP4 export.
description.zh: 和 Agent 一起做动画：场景写成可改的代码，对话旁预览时间轴、框选批注，导出逐帧精确的 MP4。

description.en: Overflow drawer for the DSH Web session header: tucks overflowing buttons into a collapsible menu with per-item visibility (auto/always/dock/hidden), group reordering, and sidebar panel toggles. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话顶栏收纳器：窄屏自动将溢出按钮收进「»」抽屉，支持逐项设自动/常显/收起/隐藏、同组排序与左栏面板逐行开关。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Bounces between the current session and the previous one with Ctrl+Tab on DSH Desktop, stopping at those two instead of walking further back.
description.zh: 桌面版按 Ctrl+Tab 在「当前会话」和「上一个会话」之间来回切，只在这两个之间打转，不会一路翻回更早的会话。

description.en: Installs the cost, facts and prune components together and adds /te, one command that reports whether each is mounted, what it measured, and how to switch one off. The components stay separately installable; this is the one-install path.
description.zh: 一次装齐成本记账、仓库事实与工具隐藏三个组件，并注册 /te：一条命令报出三者是否在运行、各自测到了什么、要关掉某一个该动哪一行。三个组件仍可单独安装，这里只是一次装齐的入口。

description.en: Long-term memory for agents: recalls memories by the situation they belong to, learns from how each use turned out, and keeps everything in one local SQLite file you can inspect.
description.zh: 为智能体提供的长期记忆：按场景回忆，根据每次使用的结果调整，并全部保存在一个可查看的本地 SQLite 文件中。

description.en: Full-disk Windows file manager tab in DSH Web right sidebar: browse all drives (A:-Z:), preview/edit text, upload/download files, stream directory ZIP archives, move across drives, and switch directory or category view. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH Web 右栏「我的电脑」全盘文件管理器：跨盘符浏览 A:-Z: 驱动器、文本预览编辑、上传下载、整目录流式打包 ZIP、剪切粘贴与目录/分类双视图。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Denies agent-issued delete commands and redirects them to a file_trash tool that moves the target into the Windows Recycle Bin; refuses an in-place rewrite of a file from its own content, and stages a share delete onto a local NTFS volume before recycling the copy.
description.zh: 拦截 agent 的删除命令，改为经 file_trash 工具移入 Windows 回收站；拒绝“读改写同一文件”，共享删除先复制到本地 NTFS 卷、校验并回收副本后再删原件。

description.en: Tiles full native DSH Web conversations side by side, preserving each session's plugins and right sidebar, with saved pane widths and order and swipe navigation on mobile.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中并排平铺完整原生会话，保留各自的插件与右侧栏，可独立调宽、记住宽度与顺序，并在手机上滑动切换。

description.en: Push a Feishu or WeChat card with the task title, the final answer and the artifact paths when a DSH conversation turn finishes.
description.zh: 对话结束时，把任务标题、最终回答和产物路径推成一张飞书或微信卡片。

description.en: Claude-style connectors: add any MCP server (Streamable HTTP with SSE fallback, or a local stdio command) from a Connectors page in the sidebar, sign in once with OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, discovery and dynamic client registration (callback returns to whatever dsh address you use, so it works on headless servers), or a bearer token; tokens live in the dsh credential store and refresh on their own, dropped connections reconnect with backoff, single tools can be switched off, and mcpServers blocks from Claude Desktop, Cursor or VS Code can be pasted in. Tools appear as mcp__<id>__<tool>.
description.zh: 类似 Claude 的连接器：在侧边栏的「Connectors」页面添加任意 MCP 服务器（Streamable HTTP，可回退到 SSE，或本地 stdio 命令），通过 OAuth 2.1 + PKCE、服务发现和动态客户端注册登录一次（回调会回到你当前使用的 dsh 地址，因此无界面服务器也可用），或使用 Bearer 令牌；令牌保存在 dsh 凭据存储中并自动刷新，断开的连接会退避重连，可单独关闭某个工具，并可粘贴 Claude Desktop、Cursor 或 VS Code 的 mcpServers 配置导入。工具名为 mcp__<id>__<tool>。

description.en: Shows the local Qianwen CLI state in a settings panel: sign-in status, a live Token expiry countdown, the active subscription plan and its remaining days, and monthly credit usage. When the Token expires it can start the CLI's browser device-code re-login from the panel, then finish it by polling in the background.
description.zh: 在设置面板里显示本机千问 CLI 的状态：登录状态、Token 到期倒计时、当前订阅套餐与剩余天数、月度额度用量；Token 过期时可直接在面板里发起 CLI 的浏览器设备码重新登录，并在后台轮询完成登录。

description.en: A read-only DSH Web workbench: one sidebar panel for workspaces and sessions, repository file trees and blobs, and Markdown document indexes, with explicit session archiving.
description.zh: DSH Web 只读工作台：一个侧栏面板查看工作区/会话、仓库文件树与 blob、Markdown 文档索引，并显式归档会话。

description.en: Workspace-isolated project progress panel in the DSH right sidebar: automatic session progress sync via systemPrompt, shell-verified checks separating completion from acceptance, zero-token Git and expandable historical session hints, bounded Quick Init, manual override protection with one-click restore, and native monochrome UI.
description.zh: DSH 原生右侧栏项目进度面板：工作区状态严格隔离、日常会话主动同步进展、真实命令退出码核对验收、0 token Git 与可展开历史会话线索、一键快速初始化、手动覆盖保护与一键恢复及石墨单色原生界面。

description.en: Read-only monitoring for HGDB and PostgreSQL 14+, including live metrics, sessions, blocking chains, Top SQL, replication status, historical trends and eight DSH agent tools.
description.zh: 面向 HGDB 与 PostgreSQL 14+ 的只读监控插件，提供实时指标、会话与阻塞链、Top SQL、复制状态、历史趋势及八个 DSH 智能体工具。

description.en: Drag a file or folder row from the Files panel into the composer, or right-click the row, to insert an @path reference chip. Falls back to plain text when the chip channel refuses insertion; drags that end outside the composer do nothing.
description.zh: 把右侧文件树里的文件/文件夹行拖进对话框，或右键该行，插入一个 @路径 引用芯片；芯片通道被拒绝时退化为纯文本。松手位置不在对话框上时不做任何事。

description.en: Search Bilibili videos from the DSH sidebar, open several independent player windows tiled into a grid wall, and control sound, batch switching and autoplay from one panel. It self-checks the PiliAurora program, its service scripts and Python, can launch PiliAurora when it is not running, and lets you fix any of those paths in a settings tab. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏搜索 B 站视频，并行打开多个独立播放窗口并自动网格排列，面板里可一键开关声音、切换下一批与自动连播。自带依赖自检（PiliAurora 程序、服务脚本、Python），PiliAurora 没在运行时可以一键拉起，路径都能在设置页手填。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Left-rail ordering for DSH: drag panel icons (mouse or touch), workspaces, sessions, and conversation view tabs; pin active sessions; lift footer entries; sink archived sessions. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 左栏排序增强：鼠标/触屏拖放面板图标、工作区、会话与对话页签，置顶会话保活状态，提升底栏按钮并下沉归档会话。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Colour-tag every session in the sidebar: pick one of four presets or a self-drawn HSV picker from the session context menu, or click the dot on a coloured row to open the same palette; right-clicking a preset cancels the colour, right-clicking a custom swatch deletes it, and one button clears all custom colours. Stores only under xwcolor.* keys in localStorage.
description.zh: 给侧栏每个会话打颜色标签：会话右键菜单里选 4 个预设色，或打开自绘 HSV 取色面板；已上色的会话行左端有小圆点，点开同一排色板。弹板里按右键＝取消该会话颜色，自定义色块按右键＝删除这一个自定义色，「恢复默认」一键清空我的颜色。只写 localStorage 的 xwcolor.* 键。

description.en: Import chat.deepseek.com history into DSH as real sessions, or export it as Markdown and JSON.
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 的历史会话导入成 DSH 真会话，或导出为 Markdown 与 JSON 文件。

description.en: Adds a Polish button to the DSH composer that restructures a draft into a clearer, editable request without sending it or adding information.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框中加入“润色”按钮，把草稿重组为更清晰、可继续编辑的请求，不自动发送，也不新增信息。

description.en: Lets one session consult another: it reads the target history into a bounded digest, has a read-only child agent answer from it, and returns provenance with every answer.
description.zh: 让一个会话去咨询另一个会话：把目标历史读成有界摘要，交给只读子会话作答，并在每次回答后附上出处（来源、截到第几条、丢弃了多少）。

description.en: A sidebar dashboard for a local Markdown knowledge base: note and file totals, topic distribution, a six-month growth line, recently updated notes, structure coverage, and to-dos that can scaffold a missing index.md in one click.
description.zh: 给本地 Markdown 知识库做的一页侧边栏仪表盘：资产总量、专题分布、六个月增长折线、最近更新、结构覆盖率，以及能一键补出缺失 index.md 的待办。

description.en: Blueprint-shaped workflows for DSH: a graph of units (start, end, soft, hard, choice, sub-blueprint), one TypeScript method file per blueprint that the plugin generates and rewrites when an upstream contract changes, a six-state runtime (normal, reminder, error, retired, stale, disconnected) that skips units it must not run, and unit, blueprint and project test modes.
description.zh: 图形化工作流蓝图：单元分开始、结束、软、硬、选择、子蓝图，每个蓝图一份由插件生成、上游契约变化时自动重写的 TypeScript 方法文件，运行按六状态（正常、提醒、报错、废弃、失效、断联）跳过不该跑的格子，另有单元、蓝图、项目三种测试。

description.en: YAPI connector for DeepSeek Harness: generate interface documentation through agent conversation and sync approved entries to a remote YAPI service, with a review card gating every write.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 连接 YAPI 服务：通过 agent 对话自动生成接口文档，经审查卡片审批后同步至远程 YAPI 文档服务。

description.en: A separate session-group board opened from a sidebar row: custom groups with drag-and-drop cards, five cards by two rows per page with a pager, group-local pin ordering, group colour dots on session rows, the group name in the row hover card, and an Assign group action in the session menu. It adds seats beside the shipped sidebar instead of replacing it, and group membership is stored in this browser.
description.zh: 侧栏新增「会话分组」看板：自定义分组、拖动卡片换组；每组 5 列 × 2 行分页，超出可翻页；置顶决定组内排序；会话行显示分组色点、悬停卡片显示分组名、右键菜单可「归入分组」。只往内置侧栏上加位置，不替换侧栏；分组数据存在浏览器本地。

description.en: Shows a desktop toast in the bottom-right corner with a short chime when a DSH turn finishes. The text is the first sentence of the reply, truncated to a configurable length; the card is skipped while a fullscreen app is active, and can also be limited to when the DSH window is not focused.
description.zh: 每轮任务结束时在屏幕右下角弹一张提示卡并播放提示音。卡片文字取该轮回复的第一句、按可配置字数截断；全屏应用在前台时跳过，也可以只在 DSH 窗口不在前台时提醒。

description.en: NetEase Cloud Music playlist toolkit: reuse the desktop client login state to search tracks, create and edit playlists, download playlist audio as mp3, and bulk-import MusicBee .mbp playlists into the cloud. Windows and a logged-in desktop client required.
description.zh: 网易云歌单工具：复用客户端登录态搜索曲目、建/改/删歌单、下载歌曲 mp3、把 MusicBee 的 .mbp 歌单批量搬上云端；需 Windows 且客户端已登录。

description.en: Shows today's earnings so far above the composer, computed from preset work hours and a daily wage, in Chinese and English and following the active theme.
description.zh: 在输入框上方实时显示今天已赚到的金额——按预设的上下班时间与日薪计算，支持中英双语并跟随深浅色主题。

description.en: DeepSeek ASR recognizer for the built-in Voice input bundle: the microphone records 16 kHz mono WAV and transcribes it through the paid /v1/tools/asr endpoint, so no model is downloaded and the transcript lands in the composer as an editable draft.
description.zh: 为内置 Voice input bundle 提供的 DeepSeek ASR 识别器：麦克风录制 16 kHz 单声道 WAV，经付费的 /v1/tools/asr 接口转写，无需下载本地模型，转写结果作为可编辑草稿插入输入框。

description.en: Replaces composer dock stats with context, cache-hit, Tok/s, and per-model usage panels, plus Codex, Gemini, and multi-provider quota gauges read from a local Magpie gateway (127.0.0.1:3425).
description.zh: 替换底栏统计区为上下文、缓存命中、Tok/s 与本会话模型用量面板，并展示来自本地 Magpie 网关（127.0.0.1:3425）的 Codex、Gemini 额度环及多平台柱状表。

description.en: Generate-and-render inline UI for DSH - the agent composes a dsh-ui component tree, the ui_compose tool lints it against the genui 0.16.0 whitelist (59 types; hard limits like carousel<=24, map<=50; discipline caps like one hero per answer) with teach-first repair diagnostics, and only lint-clean blocks get emitted for inline rendering. Local LLM, no cloud generation API.
description.zh: DSH 回复内组件生成+渲染：agent 组合 dsh-ui 组件树，ui_compose 工具按 genui 0.16.0 白名单（59 型；carousel<=24、map<=50 等硬限；每答案一个 hero 等纪律帽）做带修复诊断的起飞前 lint，只有干净块才被发出渲染。本地 LLM，无云端生成 API。

description.en: Attention-first, T3 Code-inspired inbox sidebar for DeepSeek Harness with Pinned, Active, Working, Snoozed, and Settled shelves, customizable snooze presets and calendar, ranked search, multi-select project filter, vertical sweep with 5-second undo, auto theme detection, 8-language UI, and one-click switch back to the native Workspaces sidebar.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 T3 Code 风格注意力收件箱侧边栏，支持置顶/待处理/运行中/已暂缓/已收尾分区、可编辑暂缓快捷选项与日历弹窗、高相关搜索、多选项目筛选、竖向扫选与 5 秒撤销、自动皮肤适配、8 语言界面，以及一键切回原生工作区视图。

description.en: Play local video and audio inside the sidebar preview — HTTP Range streaming keeps memory flat at any file size, nothing buffers until you press play, playback pauses when the pane is hidden, and formats the browser cannot decode hand off to a native player.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏直接播放本地视频与音频：HTTP Range 流式读取让内存不随文件变大、不点播放不缓冲、侧边栏收起即暂停；浏览器解不了的格式一键交给本机播放器。

description.en: A6API/new-api 中转站故障转移：首块内容前出错即换商家重跑，按实测缓存命中率与输出比折算真实成本选商家。
description.zh: 中转站出错就自动换商家重跑，按实测缓存命中率和输出比算真实成本，帮你省钱又稳。

description.en: Clickable agent-preset switcher in the DSH session header with its own switch engine.
description.zh: 把会话标题栏的 Agent 预设标签变成可点击下拉菜单，选中即切换，下次调用就按新预设跑。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页确认任务空闲后重启 Web 服务，让已安装或更新的插件生效。适用于有进程管理器的本机部署。
description.zh: 在设置页确认任务空闲后重启 DSH Web 服务，让刚装好或更新的插件马上生效。

description.en: Ascoder 团队代码理解能力在 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 上的插件：自学习知识层（术语/结论/踩坑经验）+ 角色化回答风格 + 项目与分支空间管理
description.zh: 给团队代码问答加个会自学的共享记忆库，术语、结论、踩坑经验都能记住并复用。

description.en: Manage the workspace, session, plugin, and mobile bundles of 模块化改良计划 in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 一个页面统一管理当前配置的工作区、会话、插件、移动端和运行时资源包，省去到处翻找。
给手机端加手势返回和 iOS 主屏应用顶部留白，每个功能都能单独开关。
用快捷键打开插件、重装本地插件包，还能起草更新审查，每项功能都能单独开关。
给会话加装模块化小功能：下一步建议、收尾备注、Agent 预设切换、提醒和标题历史，每个都能单独开关。
帮你快速查找会话、切换工作区、预览文件，还能给每个工作区单独设置默认 Agent 预设。

description.en: BMad Method 6.12.4 for dsh: 90 skills, one _bmad/ per project, per-module switches
description.zh: 把 BMad Method 6.12.4 的 90 个技能打包进 DSH，每个项目独立配置，装完就能用。
在 DSH 窗口底部开一个可调高度的终端面板，支持多标签和分屏，写命令不用来回切窗口。

description.en: DSH Web GUI top recent-session tab strip and favorites drawer plugin
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 加上像浏览器一样的最近会话标签栏和收藏抽屉，点标签就能切换会话，管理起来更顺手。

description.en: Render mermaid and svg code fences inline in DeepSeek Harness Web conversations — no files, no PNG.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 会话里直接把 mermaid 和 svg 代码围栏渲染成图表，不用存文件也不用转 PNG。

description.en: A /clear command for the DeepSeek Harness web composer: opens a new session in the current Workspace, like Claude Code's /clear.
description.zh: 在对话框输入 /clear 就能在当前工作区一键开新会话，清空上下文继续聊。

description.en: CodeQuest for DeepSeek Harness: 把真实 Token 流量与会话内容变成成就游戏，带自建排行榜
description.zh: 把真实 Token 用量和会话内容变成成就游戏，还能连自建服务器跟别人比排行榜。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中用 ChatGPT 账号登录 Codex，获取当前账号可用的模型，并将选中的模型添加到现有提供商。
description.zh: 用 ChatGPT 账号登录 Codex，挑好模型直接加进现有提供商，省去手动配置。
把配色主题和启动动画打包在一起，打开界面就能换主题，还能看开机动画。

description.en: Context strip and right-sidebar context panel for DeepSeek Harness: token breakdown, tool and MCP attribution, skills, compactions and cache usage.
description.zh: 在输入框上方显示上下文占用条，右侧栏看 token 明细、工具与 MCP 消耗、技能和缓存情况。

description.en: 左侧栏常驻的「智能体」面板：用 Markdown 定义可复用的智能体角色，运行时注册为 DSH 预设。
description.zh: 在左侧栏用 Markdown 定义可复用的智能体角色，选好工具和模型，一句话就能叫它出来干活。

description.en: 每天把会话本体、索引、人设、记忆、应用状态各备份一份到工作区外，保留最近 N 天；左侧栏「备份」可看每天备了哪些文件、手动备份、删掉某一天，第二个页签直接配 OpenList / WebDAV 网盘推送。
description.zh: 每天自动把会话、人设、记忆和应用状态备份到工作区外，只留最近几天，还能顺手推到网盘存一份。

description.en: Desktop observation and input tools for the DeepSeek Harness agent (Windows): DPI-aware screen capture and pointer position, plus move, click, drag, scroll, type, keys and window control.
description.zh: 让 AI 助手看见并操作你的 Windows 桌面，截图、点击、打字、管窗口都能干。

description.en: Outline, thumbnail and full-text navigation for the DSH sidebar document preview: PDF files and the Office documents converted to PDF.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏的 PDF 和 Office 预览加上目录、缩略图、全文搜索和阅读进度记忆，翻长文档不再费劲。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 抖音图文插件
description.zh: 在抖音创作者中心走真实页面发图文，自动传图、填标题描述、挂话题、设可见性，默认干跑更安全。

description.en: Cycles the model's thinking level through every level it declares on each click. · 给 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加一个按钮，点一下在模型支持的思考档位之间循环。
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加个按钮，点一下就在模型支持的思考档位间循环切换，省得手动翻设置。

description.en: 常驻 DSH 的英语练习挂件——中译英句子批改、内置/自定义词库拼写、每日 AI/科技阅读报告。A lightweight in-DSH English practice widget: phrase translation grading, static/custom word-bank spelling, daily AI/tech report. A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin.
description.zh: DSH 里常驻的英语练习小挂件，能批改中译英、拼单词、每天读一篇 AI 科技短文。

description.en: EPLAN Electric P8 drawing automation for DeepSeek Harness: an agent preset driven by run_code, 12 MCP tools over the EPLAN API, and a video-digest plugin.
description.zh: 在 EPLAN Electric P8 里用 AI 自动画电气图纸，通过 MCP 工具直接操作绘图流程。

description.en: 这是面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）桌面端的独立社区插件。目录从当前 DSH 实例读取已注册的 Agent Preset，专家的角色、工具和技能由各自的预设提供。
description.zh: 把 DSH 里已有的专家整理成目录，聊天时按任务挑对专家，不用手动配置。

description.en: Visual Git backup and one-click restore for DSH plugins, config and skills.
description.zh: 把 DSH 插件、配置和技能备份到 Git 仓库，需要时一键还原，桌面和命令行都能用。

description.en: Standing rule + skill for DeepSeek Harness: search GitHub for prior art before building from scratch. 造东西前先查 GitHub，三行写清候选 / 决定 / 理由。
description.zh: 造东西前先搜 GitHub 找现成方案，三行写清候选、决定和理由，避免重复造轮子。

description.en: GitHub Projects & Issues for DeepSeek Harness: workspace project board, session issue tab + subtitles, agent bind tools.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接看 GitHub 项目看板和当前会话绑定的 Issue，随时跟进任务。

description.en: 闲鱼监控 · 在 DeepSeek Harness 里部署、运行和管理 ai-goofish-monitor：对话查货、定时汇报、管理面板。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里部署和管理闲鱼监控，对话查货、定时汇报，还能用面板统一管理。

description.en: hey! deepseek harness 咕咕嘎嘎桌宠
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一只企鹅桌宠，跟着工作状态撒娇、吃鱼、睡觉，还会念叨咕咕嘎嘎。

description.en: deepseek harness 的记忆和人物属性
description.zh: 给 AI 助手加上长期记忆和人物属性，让对话能记住上下文、角色设定不跑偏。
让 DSH 手机端顶栏避开 iOS 主屏幕网页应用顶部的模糊区域，不再被遮挡。
